title: 第15章 闯大祸了第16章 段公愚
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
众人纷纷议论。
这些人大多都是来自于周围十几座城池的年轻武修。
所以都听说过秦伏天之名。
只是如今的秦伏天沦为废物，被秦家逐出门阀，让人忍不住感慨。
而这次，秦伏天在灵丹阁内打了丹童。
以灵丹阁的森严的规矩，只怕秦伏天无法活着走出来……
灵丹阁内！
众多护卫将秦伏天和秦青瑶围在其中。
徐阳愤怒地瞪着秦伏天，眼中有着疯狂之色：“秦伏天，你给老子跪下来，把老子的鞋底板舔干净，或许老子可以饶你一条狗命！你算什么东西？一个废物，也敢动手打我！”
“啪！”
然而，徐阳话音还未落下，又是一耳光抽在他的脸上。
“让你骂我家少爷！你才是废物，你全家都是废物！”
秦青瑶愤怒地瞪着徐阳，刚才这一耳光，便是她的手笔。
“嗯……不错，孺子可教！”秦伏天笑着点头。
徐阳这下更是彻底暴走！
被一个废物打了也就算了。
现在竟然连一个婢女也敢抽自己耳光？
“你这贱婢，我要你死！”
徐阳勃然大怒，他一步跨出，一记掌刀朝秦青瑶斩来。
这徐阳乃是通脉境四重天，这一记掌刀，融合了武技在其中，若是被劈中，秦青瑶必然会重伤。

“该死！你这贱婢，也敢对我动手？”
徐阳怒极，嘴角噙着冷笑，仿佛已经看到，这一掌落下之后秦青瑶的惨状！
然而他的手刀还未落在秦青瑶的身上，秦伏天的手已是从一旁探出，径直抓住徐阳的手腕。
“我的人也是你能动的？”
秦伏天冷冷一笑，手上一发力。
“啪咔！”
徐阳的手臂直接在腕处折断。
“啊……”
撕心裂肺般的惨叫声从徐阳的口里爆发出来。
他倒在地上，另外一只手捂着折断的手，疼痛得全身都在抽搐。
接着，秦伏天一脚踏出，踩在徐阳的胸口。
“你开口闭口说我是废物？现在你如一条死狗被我踩在脚下，我若是废物，那你又算什么？”
秦伏天居高临下，冷眼着看徐阳。
“咳咳……”徐阳口中咳出鲜血，他痛苦地挣扎求饶：“秦伏天，我错了！秦公子，饶了我……我是废物，我才是废物……”
“现在让我饶了你？晚了！”秦伏天冷冷一笑，脚上就要发力。
“住手！”
突然，一声怒喝，只见一名身着灰色丹袍的中年男子目光阴沉走来。
周围那些灵丹阁的护卫见到此人，纷纷让开一条道来。
content_en:
Everyone was talking about it.
Most of these people are young martial arts cultivators from more than a dozen surrounding cities.
So everyone has heard of Qin Futian.
But now that Qin Futian has been reduced to a waste and expelled from the Qin family, people can't help but sigh.
But this time, Qin Futian beat Dantong in Lingdan Pavilion.
With the strict rules of Lingdan Pavilion, I am afraid that Qin Futian will not be able to come out alive...
Inside Lingdan Pavilion!
Many guards surrounded Qin Futian and Qin Qingyao.
Xu Yang glared at Qin Futian angrily, with a look of madness in his eyes: "Qin Futian, kneel down for me and lick the soles of my shoes clean. Maybe I can spare your life! Who do you think you are? You are a waste, but you dare to hit me!"
"Crack!"
However, before Xu Yang could finish his words, he was slapped on the face again.
"I asked you to scold my young master! You are the waste, and your whole family is waste!"
Qin Qingyao glared at Xu Yang angrily. The slap just now was her handiwork.
"Hmm... that's right, a kid can be taught!" Qin Futian nodded with a smile.
Xu Yang went completely berserk now!
It’s okay to be beaten by a loser.
Now he dares to slap even a maid?
"You bitch, I want you to die!"
Xu Yang was furious. He stepped forward and slashed at Qin Qingyao with his sword.
This Xu Yang is at the fourth level of the Tongmai Realm. This palm sword incorporates martial arts into it. If he is hit, Qin Qingyao will definitely be seriously injured.
"Damn it! You, a cheap servant, dare to attack me?"
Xu Yang was extremely angry, with a sneer on his lips, as if he had already seen Qin Qingyao's miserable state after this palm fell!
However, before his knife fell on Qin Qingyao, Qin Futian's hand reached out from the side and grabbed Xu Yang's wrist.
"You can also touch my people?"
Qin Futian smiled coldly and exerted force on his hand.
"Crack!"
Xu Yang's arm was broken directly at the wrist.
"Ah..."
Heart-rending screams burst out from Xu Yang's mouth.
He fell to the ground, his other hand covering his broken hand, and his whole body was twitching in pain.
Then, Qin Futian stepped out and stepped on Xu Yang's chest.
"You keep saying that I am a waste? Now you are like a dead dog being trampled under my feet. If I am a waste, then who are you?"
Qin Futian looked down at Xu Yang coldly.
"Ahem..." Xu Yang coughed up blood. He struggled painfully and begged for mercy: "Qin Futian, I was wrong! Mr. Qin, spare me... I am a waste, I am a waste..."
"You want me to spare you now? It's too late!" Qin Futian smiled coldly and started to exert force on his feet.
"Stop!"
Suddenly, there was an angry shout, and a middle-aged man in a gray red robe walked towards him with a gloomy look.
When the surrounding Lingdan Pavilion guards saw this person, they all made way for him.
